title: Insights
help: How healthy each cluster is, what is growing, what will be needed and when, and what to fix. Pick one cluster, or All clusters for the summary. Forecasts look up to a year ahead and show a likely range.
noSamplesYet: No samples yet - the first arrive a minute after the console starts
youngHistory: Forecasts get better as history builds up: the first trends appear after an hour of samples, and they become reliable after about a week (busy days and quiet days both included).
overviewError: Could not read the server's live statistics: {{error}}
noClusters: Your access policies don't allow Insights on any cluster of this project (it needs insights.view).
recommendationsHelp: Worked out from the samples, the live statistics and Prometheus. Each says why and what to do; SQL can be copied into the SQL editor.
storageHelp: Size of all databases together, with the 30-day forecast (dashed).
tpsChartHelp: Commits and rollbacks, with the trend of the daily busy hour.
connectionsHelp: Client connections, the limit, and where the busy hour is heading.
rowsHelp: Rows read by queries and rows written (inserted, updated, deleted).
nodesSource: From Prometheus at {{url}} (node_exporter). Disk is the filesystem that holds the PostgreSQL data directory.
needsPrometheusLong: CPU, memory and disk forecasts come from the cluster's Prometheus. Add a VM with the Monitoring role to the cluster, or set the Prometheus URL on the Observability page.
noNodeMetrics: Prometheus answered, but has no node_exporter metrics for this cluster's nodes.
nodesFootnote: Suggested vCPU keeps the busy hour (p95) near 65% with next month's trend; disk to have keeps 25% free at the 30-day forecast.
databasesHelp: Size and growth of each database.
tablesHelp: The 100 biggest tables of the database: dead rows and the space they waste (bloat), growth from the hourly samples, and how they are read.
queriesHelp: Statements by total execution time (pg_stat_statements, since its last reset).
noPgss: pg_stat_statements is not enabled on this cluster - see the recommendation above.
serverLine: PostgreSQL {{version}} · up since {{started}} · shared_buffers {{sb}} · work_mem {{wm}} · cache hit {{hit}} · oldest transaction ID age {{xid}}
healthHelp: 100 = nothing to fix. Each critical finding costs 25, each warning 8, small tips up to 10 in total.
outlookHelp: The most important things the trends say, in plain words.
fadedRough: Faded numbers look much further ahead than the history behind them: treat them as rough.
capacityHelp: Every resource with where it is heading. Click a row to see its chart and the forecast for 1, 3, 6 and 12 months.
capacityEmpty: No capacity data yet. It appears after the console has collected a few samples.
modelLine: {{model}} · {{growth}} per month · fit {{r2}} · from {{span}} days of history · {{confidence}}
milestonesHelp: Expected value and the likely range (95 %).
over100: Above 100 % means more than the node has: the extra work would wait in a queue.
howLines: The console saves a sample every few minutes (database sizes, transactions, connections) and reads CPU, memory and disk from Prometheus.
It draws the best straight line through the history. If the history curves upward (it grows by a percentage, like interest), it uses compound growth instead - but only when that fits clearly better.
The likely range is where the value lands 95 times out of 100 if the trend stays the same. It gets wider the further ahead it looks.
Looking far ahead of a short history is marked rough. Compound growth is never projected beyond 1000 x today.
Status: Act = the limit is reached within the look-ahead, Watch = the warning level is reached, OK = neither.
fleetHelp: Every cluster you can see, worst first. Summaries refresh every hour; click a row to open that cluster.
fleetTableHelp: Health score, nodes running, data and growth, and the main concern of each cluster.
fleetRisksHelp: The most important outlook lines from all clusters.
fleetGrowthHelp: Size today and expected in one year, on one scale.
